# cloud-computing

> A plain-language glossary of cloud computing, AI/ML, data, and infrastructure terms.

## Overview

cloud-computing is a documentation repository by nirholas: a plain-language glossary of 153 cloud computing, AI/ML, data analytics, database, and infrastructure terms, grouped by topic and also published as a JSON block at the end of the README.

## Repository

- URL: https://github.com/nirholas/cloud-computing
- Language: Markdown
